name: unicode-mf2-showcase
description: Advanced Unicode MF2 examples plus a labeled 36-variant composition. English source, French demo translations, Polish/Arabic plural and bidi samples. Local demo; translations need review. See source comments for provenance and sample arguments.

messages.title: Party invitation: gender × guest count, 12 variants
messages.notes: Two selectors; exact 0/1/2 keys and fallback. French uses the same possessive regardless of the host’s gender. Try hostGender=female, guestCount=2, hostName=Alex, guestName=Camille. French is a demo translation.

messages.title: Four local declarations and number styles
messages.notes: One input reused through four formatted locals. Uses the website’s legacy style=percent spelling. Run with num=3.1415927. Locale formatting is validated with Mojito’s Intl registry; the editor’s portable preview does not implement every number option.

cases.expected:
The number in scientific notation is 3.1415927E0. As a percentage, it's 314%.
Formatted with at least four integer digits and four fractional digits, it's
0,003.1416. Formatted with at most six significant digits, it's 3.14159.

En notation scientifique : 3,1415927E0. En pourcentage : 314 %.
Avec au moins quatre chiffres entiers et quatre décimales : 0 003,1416.
Avec au plus six chiffres significatifs : 3,14159.

knownLimitations: The current Mojito Intl adapter ignores notation, legacy style=percent, minimumIntegerDigits, and significant-digit options in this official example. Validation records the mismatch against native Intl reference formatting.

messages.title: Paired and standalone markup
messages.notes: link/bold/star-icon are application-defined markup. MF2 returns structured parts; it does not turn these tags into HTML. Try count=32. French is a demo translation.

cases.expected: Click here. 32
Cliquez ici. 32

messages.title: Custom grammatical-case selector and person formatter
messages.notes: Capability boundary: ns:hasCase and ns:person are illustrative host functions from Unicode, not built-in inflection. Mojito stores/edits this source, but its normal runtime cannot resolve those functions. Validation demonstrates both the missing-function result and a tiny fixture-only registry using supplied forms (no grammar inference).

cases.expected: Hello, Mario!
Please welcome Marii!
Hello!
Bonjour, Camille !
Accueillez Camille !
Bonjour !

messages.title: Overlapping wildcard matches and precedence
messages.notes: The most specific matching combination wins even though it appears after wildcard rows. Try foo=foo, bar=bar; then change either value. French is a demo translation.

cases.expected: Foo and bar
Foo and any
Any and bar
Otherwise
Foo et bar

messages.notes: English source and Polish target come from Unicode. French and Arabic are demo translations. Polish: try 1,2,5,22,1.5. Arabic: try 0,1,2,3,11,100. Locale-specific categories can differ from the English source.

messages.title: Four date/time styles, fixed UTC zone
messages.source:
Short: {$date :datetime dateStyle=short timeStyle=short timeZone=UTC}.
Medium: {$date :datetime dateStyle=medium timeStyle=medium timeZone=UTC}.
Long: {$date :datetime dateStyle=long timeStyle=long timeZone=UTC}.
Full: {$date :datetime dateStyle=full timeStyle=full timeZone=UTC}.

translations.fr:
Court : {$date :datetime dateStyle=short timeStyle=short timeZone=UTC}.
Moyen : {$date :datetime dateStyle=medium timeStyle=medium timeZone=UTC}.
Long : {$date :datetime dateStyle=long timeStyle=long timeZone=UTC}.
Complet : {$date :datetime dateStyle=full timeStyle=full timeZone=UTC}.

messages.notes: Based on Unicode’s date/time styles example; adds timeZone=UTC for reproducibility. Try date=2024-10-25T14:05:06Z. Runtime output is validated with the Intl registry. Mojito’s portable editor preview has no date/time formatter.

messages.title: 36 variants: gender × status × count, date, currency, link
messages.notes: Authored for this Mojito showcase, not a published Unicode example. Three selectors produce 36 combinations. Also uses two locals, localized date/currency and a link with a variable option. All 36 English and French branches are exercised by validate.mjs. Try hostGender=female, status=ready, guestCount=2, hostName=Alex, date=2026-09-18T18:00:00Z, price=25, url=https://example.org/events/demo. Date/currency need the Intl registry.

messages.title: Mixed-direction name and file path
messages.notes: Authored from Unicode’s bidi isolation rules. Arabic name plus an LTR path; u:dir supplies direction metadata. Runtime parts retain isolation information. Try userName=ليلى and path=reports/2026-Q3.csv. French and Arabic are demo translations.
